purpose: Detect unreliable region-level localization without replacing a frozen proposer
training: No additional neural network is trained; all descriptors use the first supplied target box
external_test_split: SurgT provided test partition; evaluated only after parameter and alarm threshold freeze
preprocessing: Official stereo rectification; use left view and retain every decoded frame for online updates
scored_frames: Visible, non-difficult, valid left-view GT boxes after initialization; fixed independently of predictions
selection_objective: Equal-sequence mean failure AUROC on validation, averaged across both frozen proposers
threshold_selection: Validation 90th percentile of reliable-frame risk (nominal specificity 0.90); no test-label calibration
statistical_unit: Sequence, with case-cluster bootstrap sensitivity analysis; unknown patient overlap explicitly disclosed
localization_output: The underlying proposer box is unchanged, so verifier cannot improve or worsen its box IoU by construction
limitations: Historical work on SurgT exists; this is a newly frozen cross-benchmark validation, not claimed as a never-seen patient cohort
The native benchmark reset/EAO scoring is not reproduced; this protocol uses continuous no-GT-reset tracking
Annotation-free refers to descriptor construction, not the initial target box or labeled validation calibration
A useful reliability monitor does not prove better localization or improved clinical navigation
